title: Open when you miss me
content: vaise hmko bhut mann tha ki tm hmko saree me dekho pr ho nhi paaya aisa. aagein kab mauka mile pta nhi... isliye ye rhe hmm😂.Tmko pta h na ki hm mumbai sirf kaam krne jaa rhe mera dhyan toh patna aur tmhare paas hi laga rhega. aur hnn koi miss viss krne jaisa baat hi nhi, tmhare paas hi hain hm, bass tmko realise nhi hota☺️.Vaishnavi tmhari hi hai khargosh, hehehe.

title: Open when life feels heavy
content: jab jyada tension ho toh bass ye socha kro ki tmhare gharwale tmse kitna pyaar krte, tmhari care krte, tmhare liye roz pray krte, aur hm bhi krte. Toh itne saare log jiske saath h, uska tension kuch nhi bigaad payega.Saare problems solve hojayenge vaise bhi linear grapgh utna accha nhi lgta thoda sa sinusoidal hona banta h.VAISE BADE BADE SEHRON ME CHHOTI CHHOTI BAATEIN HOTI REHTI HAIN SENORITA😂.

title: Birthday Letter
content: Khargosh,tmko bhut saari best wishes x10times. Happy raha kro, health pe dhyan rkha kro aur mere kanhaji aur hm toh hain hi tmhare sath hmesha😌.Tmhare mere life me aane se mere life m bhut happiness aayi khargosh, hm apne best version se mile h.Tm sach m dil ke bhut acche ho, bass thode khadus ho specially mere liye,kyunki hm special hain na, hehehehehehe...HAPPY BIRTHDAY KHARGOSH🥳.
